items.author: Chandeep Chhabra, Oct 23
items.summary: A 5-step guide to using Claude Code with Power BI: save the report as a .pbip project, open it in VS Code, prompt Claude to make the edits, then click Apply external changes in Power BI Desktop. He says this works better than the Power BI Modeling MCP because it can edit visuals too.
